338	## State Patterns
   339	
   340	### Pet behaviors (addendum §4.4)
   341	
   342	| Situation | Child sees | Detail |
   343	|---|---|---|
   344	| Talk unavailable | Resting ears | Ears fold neatly (asset gaps); 0.8 s out with a small ear shake when talk returns. First time per child profile: the FR-8 narrator line; later, only the folded ears. Voice features hidden; ear tap → basic-mode ear reaction |
   345	| Heat (FR-8) | Pip naps, then plays with resting ears | Talk pauses and Pip naps on the rug where it stands (no dim, not the bed; pose and wake-up: Asset gaps > Nap (heat)). A tap wakes it and play goes on with resting ears until the device cools, so nothing that works in basic mode stops (FR-8); untouched, Pip naps until the device cools, then wakes with its ears back. Nap time is not play time `[ASSUMPTION]` |
   346	| Mishearing | Head tilt or comic guess | `mishear` / `confused`; the fallback set |
   347	| Caps and bedtime | Pip yawns and sleeps | Wind-down, then sleeping Pip |
   348	| Ladder pacing | "Full of words" | The "full" reaction, then the ball; resets at the next Day `[ASSUMPTION: CQ-37]` |
   349	| Low storage | Pip tidies its toy box | Once per visit, at the start, Pip carries a toy to the toy box; an animation only, no toy leaves the room (FR-15.2); the parent area says how much space is needed |
   350	| A need (hungry, sleepy) | One ≤ 3 s animation | Only during a visit and only from play in that visit (e.g. after a game or a bath); never from time away; never during the greeting, the AI-notice card or wind-down; at most once per visit; one care action meets it; never escalates. Neutral or happy face (belly pat, glance at the bowl), never `sad` or `vox_pip_sad_whimper` `[ASSUMPTION: CQ-37]` |
   351	| Sad | At most one reaction | One sad loop (≤ 3 s), then none; `vox_pip_sad_whimper` at most once; never at a goodbye, wind-down, sleep or resting ears, on a "no" tap, after an absence, or in reply to a feeling the child states (FR-14.3) |
   352	| Absence ≥ 7 days | "Just back from a trip" | The visit opens with the `P08` arrival door at the room's left edge: Pip knocks (`sfx_trip_door_knock`) and hops in (`return_trip`) `[ASSUMPTION]`; the souvenir lands in the toy corner as a toy `[ASSUMPTION: CQ-37]`; never sad |
   353	
   354	### Resting ears by cause (FR-8)
   355	
   356	The child view is identical for every cause; nothing that works in basic mode stops. The parent area names the cause on a status card and in About this device.
   357	
   358	| Cause | Tier | Leaves | Parent area says |
   359	|---|---|---|---|
   360	| Offline | Server | Next visit with a connection `[ASSUMPTION: not mid-visit]` | The device is offline |
   361	| Server unavailable or slow (connection error, or two turns in a row over 6 s) | Server | Next visit | Our servers were slow or unavailable |
   362	| Talk allowance used up | Server | Next visit after the wake time | Today's allowance is used; it resets at the wake time |
   363	| No consent yet (restore or setup without consent) | Server | Consent completed | "Give consent" |
   364	| Consent revoked or declined by the parent | Server | Consent given in Linking and consent | Information card, no nudge (Status card) |
   365	| Setup not finished (FR-85) | Both | Talk steps done | The missing step; "Finish setup" |
   366	| Model not yet downloaded, or removed | On-device | Model ready | Download state |
   367	| Heat | Both | Device cools | The nap, then resting ears until the device cools |
   368	| Refund | Both | A new purchase | "The unlock was refunded; Pip keeps everything and plays without talking." |
   369	| Tier change (FR-5, FR-6) | Both | The parent chooses | The new tier's options as an Equal choice pair; refund even after 14 days. Basic mode chosen → information card (Status card) |
   370	| Guaranteed date passed | Server | — | Server talk has ended; basic mode continues |
   371	| App update needed (server-tier security emergency only; FR-8.3, FR-93) | Server | The update is installed; talk returns at the next eligible visit | "A security update is needed for talk through our servers. Update the app; the unlock and Pip's saved things stay." No paid renewal is asked for |
   372	
   373	Model updates (FR-98) rest the ears only when storage cannot hold both models during the swap, or for the rest of a process whose new model fails its warm-up (Model download and progress).
   374	
   375	### Bedtime and the caps (FR-59–FR-61, FR-56)
   376	
   377	| Moment | Behavior |
   378	|---|---|
   379	| Wind-down | 5 minutes before a cap or bedtime: `sleepy` overlay, occasional `yawn_stretch`, slower loops; the wave button shows. No timer, text or return cue. Opening the app inside those 5 minutes starts it at once `[ASSUMPTION]` |
   380	| At the cap or bedtime | The 60-minute AI notice plays the moment it is due, with the break suggestion (an activity in progress pauses under the frame and resumes) → any teach, game or show-and-tell finishes (≤ 60 s) → goodnight `wave` (`vox_pip_bye_babble`) → `fall_asleep` into the bed → sleeping Pip (UJ-11) |
   381	| Sleeping Pip | {colors.sleep-dim} at 40%, lamp on (`W11`, `sfx_room_lamp_click` at `fall_asleep`); `amb_night_loop` at night (a daytime cap keeps quiet time-of-day ambience); `mus_bedtime_loop` once, then ambience. Controls: wave (goodnight), grown-ups sign, grown-ups door, profile door. Tapping Pip: it stirs and sleeps on. Not play time |
